description: The developer's projects: account → projects → apps. Every account has the project "Explorer" (it can be renamed, not deleted) and new apps land there. The free quota is the account's; Pro and the quota packs are the project's (neblla_billing with projectId). Stripe (who the apps sell as), Cloudflare (one token for the developer's server boxes, neblla_byos) and the database (neblla_byodb) are set on the account, and a project may put its own and inherit the rest. "list": the projects, their apps, plan, pool and connections, with where each comes from (project or account). "cloudflare_check" { projectId? }: checks the token's rights and R2 again (after R2 was turned on or the token widened). "cloudflare_setup" { projectId? }: every Cloudflare topic ("media", "domain", "mail", "server") with its steps (account, token rights, R2 turned on) and what is done, the Cloudflare link that creates the token already filled (tokenLink.url; tokenLink.manual: rights to add by hand on the same form), the sign-up link, and panelUrl, where the developer pastes the token in a box (it is never pasted in the chat). Changes nothing; neblla_projects creates, moves and connects.
name: neblla_projects_read
title: Projects (read)
